tokens.name: --color-correct
tokens.description: Correct-answer mark — the only green in the interface. Use it on ui/check when the tutor is judging the student's work: correct findings in state/evaluation. Always a 2pt stroke on a 22px glyph — never a fill, background, chip, banner or text. NOT for completion or progress (a finished plan step is done, not correct), NOT for system success such as "saved" or "connected", NOT for the tutor's own states. Cool viridian, chosen to sit under the violet-leaning neutrals; at oklch chroma 0.095 it is under half the brand's 0.203, so --color-brand stays the loudest colour on screen. It is NOT --color-pen-green #40A365 and must never alias it — the pen is what the student draws with, and the interface must not answer in the student's own ink. 6.33:1 on --color-surface-panel #FCFCFC. Glyph shape still carries the meaning; colour only speeds it up.

tokens.name: --color-incorrect
tokens.description: Incorrect-answer mark — the only red in the interface. Use it on ui/cross when the tutor is judging the student's work: incorrect findings in state/evaluation. Always a 2pt stroke on a 22px glyph — never a fill, background, chip, banner or text. NOT for failure states: network and auth errors stay --color-ink copy with a --color-icon glyph, because the tutor failing is not the student being wrong. NOT for destructive, warning or validation UI. Deep alizarin, deliberately quieter than a signal red — matched to --color-correct at the same contrast and lightness so the cross never outshouts the checks above it; the board's rule is never lead with the mistake. It is NOT --color-pen-red #E33E38 and must never alias it — the pen is what the student draws with. 6.37:1 on --color-surface-panel #FCFCFC.

tokens.name: --color-icon
tokens.description: Default icon stroke — tool rail glyphs and panel controls.

tokens.name: --color-surface-bubble
tokens.description: Fill for the student's own message bubbles and the attached-selection bubble in the thread. The only grey that sits ON a panel rather than behind one.

tokens.name: --color-divider
tokens.description: Hairline rules inside a surface — the tool-rail divider. This is the ONLY border colour in the product; every other separation is done with elevation, not stroke.

tokens.name: --color-shadow
tokens.description: The single hue every shadow in the product is built from. Never used as a fill. Applied at four alphas — see the Elevation scale in Foundations.

tokens.name: --font-doc
tokens.description: Montserrat. DESIGN-DOCUMENTATION BOARDS ONLY — not used anywhere in the product. The shipping UI is a single family: --font-sans.

tokens.name: --font-sans
tokens.description: Source Sans 3. The product's only typeface — every text node on every live screen uses it.

tokens.name: --font-mono
tokens.description: DESIGN-DOCUMENTATION BOARDS ONLY — used for spec values, token names and measurements so they are unambiguous to read. Not used in the product.

tokens.name: --text-label
tokens.description: Status bar, the "Selection" attachment label, and small meta. The smallest size in the product — nothing goes below this.

tokens.name: --text-body
tokens.description: Default body size at PANEL scale (337pt column): message text, suggestion-chip labels, composer placeholder. The workhorse — most text in the product is this.

tokens.name: --text-body-lg
tokens.description: Suggestion-chip labels at FULL-SCREEN scale (740pt column). Same component as --text-body, stepped up because the reading column is wider.

tokens.name: --text-lead
tokens.description: Lead paragraph and composer placeholder at FULL-SCREEN scale. Pairs with --text-display.

tokens.name: --text-title
tokens.description: Greeting headline at PANEL scale ("Hi! I'm your AI Tutor" in the 337pt column).

tokens.name: --text-display
tokens.description: Greeting headline at FULL-SCREEN scale. The largest type in the product; appears exactly once per screen.

tokens.name: --font-weight-regular
tokens.description: Body copy, message text, placeholders.

tokens.name: --font-weight-medium
tokens.description: Suggestion-chip labels.

tokens.name: --font-weight-semibold
tokens.description: Headings, status bar, the selection label. The heaviest weight the product uses.

tokens.name: --font-weight-bold
tokens.description: Documentation boards only — the product never goes above semibold.

tokens.name: --tracking-tight
tokens.description: Applied to --text-title and --text-display only. Large type needs the air taken out of it.

tokens.name: --tracking-wide
tokens.description: All-caps eyebrow labels on the documentation boards.

tokens.name: --leading-label

tokens.name: --leading-tight

tokens.name: --leading-control
tokens.description: Single-line text inside a control (composer placeholder at panel scale). Tighter than body because the text is vertically centred, never wrapped.

tokens.name: --leading-snug
tokens.description: Suggestion-chip labels and short centred body copy.

tokens.name: --leading-body
tokens.description: Running body text — message bubbles and any wrapped paragraph at --text-body.

tokens.name: --leading-lead
tokens.description: Pairs with --text-lead in the full-screen greeting.

tokens.name: --leading-title
tokens.description: Pairs with --text-title in the panel greeting.

tokens.name: --leading-display
tokens.description: Pairs with --text-display in the full-screen greeting.

tokens.name: --container-screen
tokens.description: iPad Pro 13-inch landscape width in points. The product is a single-device layout — there are no breakpoints.

tokens.name: --container-rail
tokens.description: Tool rail width. Fixed — the rail never resizes.

tokens.name: --container-panel-content
tokens.description: Usable content width inside the tutor panel = --container-panel minus 2 × --space-panel-inset. Every child of the panel is this wide.

tokens.name: --container-panel
tokens.description: Tutor panel width when docked beside the board.

tokens.name: --container-column
tokens.description: Reading column in the full-screen tutor state — greeting, suggestion grid and composer all align to this.

tokens.name: --spacing-1
tokens.description: Base grid unit. Every spacing value in the product is a multiple of 4 except --space-message-gap (22).

tokens.name: --spacing-2
tokens.description: Icon-to-label gap in tight controls.

tokens.name: --spacing-3
tokens.description: Send-button inset inside the composer pill.

tokens.name: --spacing-4
tokens.description: Composer icon-to-text gap; collapsed-dock gap.

tokens.name: --spacing-5
tokens.description: Suggestion-grid gap at full-screen scale.

tokens.name: --spacing-6
tokens.description: Same value as --space-gap. Prefer the semantic name for layout.

tokens.name: --spacing-7
tokens.description: Same value as --space-edge. Prefer the semantic name for layout.

tokens.name: --spacing-8
tokens.description: Composer pill left inset at full-screen scale.

tokens.name: --spacing-10
tokens.description: Reserved.

tokens.name: --spacing-12
tokens.description: Reserved.

tokens.name: --space-edge
tokens.description: Screen edge to any panel. The outermost margin — 28pt on all four sides.

tokens.name: --space-gap
tokens.description: Between two panels (rail↔board, board↔tutor), and from a board edge to anything floating inside it.

tokens.name: --space-content
tokens.description: Reading-layout inset in the full-screen tutor state.

tokens.name: --space-panel-inset
tokens.description: Panel edge to its contents. Panel width minus 2× this = --container-panel-content.

tokens.name: --space-message-gap
tokens.description: Vertical gap between consecutive messages in the thread. Deliberately off the 4px grid — 24px read as too loose and 20px too dense at 17px body.
